The behavior_quote demonstrates how evidence flows are derived from interop events, but it does not establish that this path is taken when the interop adapter is available or that the legacy path is taken when it is unavailable. Without evidence connecting interop adapter availability to the selection of each path and its corresponding evidence-flow derivation, the claim's routing and provenance assertions are not demonstrated.
